component.name: Breadcrumb
component.description: Hierarchical navigation trail showing user's location within site structure.

parts.label: breadcrumb item
parts.description: Individual breadcrumb representing a page or section.

layout.width: fills available width, wraps if needed
constraints: Breadcrumbs wrap to multiple lines if container width insufficient.
Last item (current page) never has href and is not clickable.
Separator does not appear after last item.

backgrounds.hover: transparent (links inherit hover from Link component)

visualStyle.iconMotion: No icons. Separator is static text.

behavior.map: Breadcrumb displays hierarchical trail. Links navigate to parent pages. Current page is non-interactive text. Automatically hides if items array is empty.
behavior.rendering: Returns null if items array is empty. Renders all items with separators between.
behavior.defaultState: Displays all provided items with visual hierarchy (links vs current).

logic.effect: Navigates to parent page via Next.js Link (client-side navigation).

feedback.hover: Links inherit hover state from Link component (color change, underline).
feedback.focus: Links show focus ring (inherited from Link component).
feedback.disabled: Not applicable (current page is non-clickable span).

states.empty: Component returns null (no items to display).

layout: Breadcrumbs wrap if container width insufficient.
Minimum of 1 item required (otherwise component returns null).
Separator always between items, never trailing.
content: Items array defines breadcrumb trail order.
Last item automatically treated as current page (no href).
Label text should be concise (15-30 characters per item ideal).
nesting: Breadcrumb items should contain plain text, not complex components.
Links use Next.js Link component for optimized navigation.

aria.label: nav has aria-label='Breadcrumb' (default, customizable via prop).
aria.current: Last item could use aria-current='page' but currently omitted (implicit via styling).

accessibility.keyboard: Standard link keyboard navigation (Tab to focus, Enter to activate).
accessibility.focus: Links show visible focus indicator (inherited from Link component).
accessibility.contrast: Text meets WCAG AA contrast ratio (4.5:1 minimum).

responsiveness.rules: Breadcrumbs wrap to multiple lines on narrow screens. Consider truncating middle items with ellipsis on very small screens (not currently implemented).

then.consider: truncating middle items with ellipsis (future enhancement)

usageNotes: Provide items array with { label, href? } objects.
Last item automatically becomes current page (no href needed).
Use concise labels (15-30 chars) for better mobile experience.
Component auto-hides if items array is empty.
Customize aria-label via 'aria-label' prop for i18n support.
Links use Next.js Link for client-side navigation (no full page reload).
Consider max 4-5 breadcrumb items for optimal UX.
